```{r}

# Install packages
#install.packages(c("WDI", "tidyverse"))

# Load required libraries
library(WDI)
library(tidyverse)

```

```{r}

wdi_vars <- c(
  "SE.ADT.1524.LT.ZS",   # Youth literacy rate (% ages 15–24)
  "IT.NET.USER.ZS",      # Internet users (% of population)
  "NY.GDP.PCAP.CD"       # GDP per capita (current US$)
)

```

```{r}
# Download data (use 2022 for now but later we need to explain why 2022)
edu_raw <- WDI(
  country = "all",
  indicator = wdi_vars,
  start = 2022,
  end = 2022,
  extra = TRUE,   # includes income group
  cache = NULL
)
```

```{r}
# Define WDI indicator codes(we can add more variables later)
wdi_vars <- c(
  "SE.ADT.1524.LT.ZS",   # Youth literacy rate (% ages 15–24)
  "IT.NET.USER.ZS",       # Internet users (% of population)
  "NY.GDP.PCAP.CD"         # GDP per capita (current US$)
)

# Clean and rename manually
edu_clean <- edu_raw %>%
  filter(region != "Aggregates") %>%  # Remove regional summary rows
  select(
    country,
    youth_literacy = `SE.ADT.1524.LT.ZS`,
    internet = `IT.NET.USER.ZS`,
    gdp_per_capita = `NY.GDP.PCAP.CD`,
    income
  ) %>%
  drop_na()  # Drop rows with missing values

# Preview
head(edu_clean)
```

```{r}
str(edu_clean)

```

```{r}
nrow(edu_clean)
length(unique(edu_clean$country))

```

```{r}
summary(edu_clean)

```


```{r}
ggplot(edu_clean, aes(x = internet)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, fill = "skyblue", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Internet Usage", x = "Internet Use (%)", y = "Number of Countries")

```
```{r}
ggplot(edu_clean, aes(x = internet, y = youth_literacy)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  labs(title = "Internet Use vs. Youth Literacy Rate",
       x = "Internet Use (% of population)",
       y = "Youth Literacy Rate (%)")

```
```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)

# Scatterplot: GDP vs. Internet Usage, colored by Youth Literacy Rate
ggplot(edu_clean, aes(x = gdp_per_capita, y = internet, color = youth_literacy)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) + 
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "viridis", name = "Youth Literacy (%)") +
  labs(
    title = "GDP per Capita vs. Internet Usage",
    subtitle = "Color shows Youth Literacy Rate",
    x = "GDP per Capita (US$)",
    y = "Internet Use (% of Population)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() 


```
